name: zimage_base_t2i
description: Z-Image (undistilled base) text-to-image (Comfy-Org template image_z_image): the Turbo graph with z_image_bf16, real CFG 4 and a negative prompt, res_multistep/simple, AuraFlow shift 3. 28 steps (the Tongyi card says 28-50; the template ships 25). Shares Turbo's Qwen3 4B encoder and ae VAE. Apache-2.0.

negative.default: blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, watermark, text artifacts

requires.assumed: same nodes as the installed Z-Image Turbo graph; only the weights and sampling numbers change
